title: Finite ordinary exchange with the actual module and site comparisons
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell
e p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$ for $n\ge1$. Use [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Let $f:X	o Y$, $g:Y'	o Y$, $g':X'	o X$, $f':X'	o Y'$ be a Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] of separated finite-type $k$-schemes and separated finite-type $k$-morphisms. Write $\operatorname{Ex}_*(K):Lg^*Rf_*K	o Rf'_*Lg'^*K$ for the specified adjunction-mate exchange [def-exchange-projection]. Assume $f$ proper or $g$ smooth. For $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A_n)$ the constant-module mate is an isomorphism; under the canonical forget-coefficients comparisons it is the abelian torsion base-change exchange. If $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ has an etale-origin witness $\alpha:
u_X^*L\simeq K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], the actual ambient ringed mate is an isomorphism when $f$ is proper; when $g$ is smooth require $L$ bounded constructible and $K\simeq
u_X^*L$. More precisely, let $E_L$ be the etale module exchange and let $S_L,T_L$ be the canonical pullback/direct-image comparison isomorphisms with types
$$S_L:
u_{Y'}^*g^{-1}Rf_*L\xrightarrow{\sim}Lg^*Rf_*
u_X^*L,\qquad T_L:
u_{Y'}^*Rf'_*g'^{-1}L\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*Lg'^*
u_X^*L.$$
Then $T_L
u_{Y'}^*(E_L)=\operatorname{Ex}_*(
u_X^*L)S_L$, and conjugating by $\alpha$ identifies the map at $K$. In the smooth theorems' notation $(f_s,g_s,h_s,e_s)$ the role matching is $(g,f,f',g')$; the smooth arrow is our $g$, the qcqs arrow is our $f$, and the output corner is $Y'$. The smooth pro-etale conclusion is in the ambient derived category and asserts no constructible landing of the endpoints. It applies in particular to bounded constructible finite-Tor inputs.

proof.text: For the spectral absolute value, spectralNorm_extends and Padic.norm_p_lt_one give |ell|<1. The membership characterization from extension_integers_dvr places ell in the recorded maximal ideal. Its chosen uniformizer generates this ideal. Ideal.pow_mem_pow places ell^n in the nth power, the defining quotient ideal. Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem then proves (ell^n:A_n)=0, also after ULift. Since ell is prime, ell^n is nonzero. For every x in A_n, (ell^n)x=0, giving IsAddTorsion directly. No finiteness theorem for A_n is needed.

proof.text: The finite-field datum gives CharP k_0 p from its cardinality and CharP k p via the injective algebra map. CharP.isUnit_natCast_iff and the distinct primes ell,p make ell a unit in k. Map this unit along the structural map k to global sections of each SixFunctorSpace, then take its nth power. This verifies the exact invertible-order torsion hypothesis for every A_n-module sheaf.

proof.text: For proper f, apply Etale.isIso_baseChange_of_isProper_of_isAddTorsion_ring, the module-valued form recorded by thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below, to the additive torsion coefficient ring. For smooth g, use the already proved source theorem Etale.isIso_baseChange_app_of_smooth_of_isTorsionSheafOfInvertibleOrder (WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.SmoothBaseChange.Derived). Its proof applies sbc-thm-smooth-base-change to sheaves and extends by triangulated truncation devissage to D+. The helper of_natCast_eq_zero gives its cohomology hypothesis from ell^n and its invertibility. This is the same bounded-below smooth route in direct module coordinates, avoiding conversion through the abelian allowable-torsion wrapper.

proof.text: Use baseChange_eq_derivedBaseChangeMapPlus and the exchange equation in exchange_forget_coefficients to prove the required coefficient-forgetting identity. Apply comparison_derivedBaseChangeMap to obtain the specified S,T identity. Cancel the source comparison to express the ambient mate at the comparison image as S inverse followed by the comparison image of the etale mate followed by T.

proof.text: Naturality of the actual ambient transformation at W.iso.hom and cancellation of W.iso.inv_hom_id give the five-factor conjugation formula. The etale mate is invertible by the proper/smooth step, and functors preserve all the isomorphisms in the formula. Thus the ambient mate at K is invertible. The proof works for all D+ antecedents under hgeom, and consequently for each bounded constructible antecedent required by the smooth clause. No endpoint constructibility claim is made.
